  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The `Permission prompts:` output template contains malformed angle-bracket syntax at `<error>><; classifier outage: <n> (not filed)]`.
  WHY: The template grouping is syntactically invalid (the `<error>` tag is closed by `>>`, and then a new group is opened by `<;`). A stage session reading this template will render garbled report text or invalid delimiter literals instead of a correctly formatted outage report line.
- workflow-templates/.claude/scripts/permission_prompts.py:95 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: `CLASSIFIER_OUTAGE_REASON_RE` is compiled with `re.DOTALL`, which allows `.` to span newlines in the denial reason.
  WHY: A multiline `PermissionDenied` reason that happens to include a verdict-negation phrase on a newline (e.g., "Permission denied due to policy.\nClassifier: unavailable") will be incorrectly misclassified as a classifier outage, excluding it from filing and hiding real permission gaps.
- workflow-templates/.claude/scripts/permission_prompts.py:498-507 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: `file_patterns()` and `report()` independently load, decode, and partition the same log records.
  WHY: Each stage-end report performs duplicate disk I/O and JSON parsing for the same log file per invocation, wasting resources unnecessarily.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
